text.p: Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Friday she upgraded her rating for Northland Cranberries Inc to a strong buy from a neutral based, in part, on growing sales of the company's shelf-stable cranberry drinks nationwide.

-- The Cranberry Marketing Committee of the U.S. Department of Agriculture says it will meet this month on alleged adulteration issues involving cranberry juice drinks, she said in a report. The USDA involvement will help curb these alleged practices, which have the effect of artificially increasing the supply of cranberries and consequently depressing prices, she said.
-- In addition, Wittenburg said the cranberry crop is looking good, especially in Wisconsin where Northland has more than 80 percent of its acreage.
-- Shares of Northland were trading up 1/4 to 17-1/4.
